request.text: Collab 以统一基础通信能力模块为基础。注册按 daemon 可取得的运行时能力自动决定：存在 tmux pane 就按当前 pane 的 tmux adaptor 注册；没有 tmux pane 时，daemon 按通信要求选择已有 adaptor 并完成通信回环。能力选择、可达性和探测由 daemon 负责，不由 agent 指定或自行执行。tmux 的 pane 收发是基础模块能力。统一通信状态须持久化身份锚点、adaptor 绑定、收发回执，daemon 重启后自动恢复并同步漂移。DSH 复合锚点为 sessionID + communication API。context 返回当前注册身份以及整个项目的 peer/master 状态。所有消息先由 daemon 中心化接收、持久化并派发到目标身份，不做绕过 daemon 的 agent-to-agent 点对点直连；通信方式由 daemon 决定，agent 只指定找谁。身份确认、恢复、可达性维护与 adaptor 切换由 daemon 后台自动完成；context 请求和 daemon 的周期查询均可触发/提供状态更新，但 agent 不负责手工恢复。用户授权优先级最高：用户明确要求 master 或 peer 时，daemon 直接覆盖当前身份/角色映射；除确实没有通信能力外，不因现存身份、角色、可达性瞬态或未知状态拒绝或返回 unknown。基础能力建立后，周期通知、长程通知、订阅消息与通信流程都要持久化、静默感知、自动派发并画明；消息入队、adaptor 接受、收到和消费分别按真实事实记录。用户未指定的周期、重试、聚合和提醒参数不得臆定。

result.text: Collab 注册由 agent 主动发起，通过 Skill 报告自己的能力事实、tmux pane 等信息；报告用于 daemon 核实，不授权 agent 选择 transport 或声明要求。daemon 对照自身拥有的能力与运行事实核实报告；报告与 daemon 不一致时 daemon 的事实为准。若当前 pane 经 daemon 核实存在，按 tmux 注册；否则 daemon 根据通信要求选择可用 adaptor 并完成通信回环。注册时，回环测试是所选通信路径能力和可达性的权威判据；报告、配置或探测意图不能替代成功回环。身份及角色、稳定 anchor 和已选择的 adaptor 绑定均持久化。身份丢失或 daemon 重启后，daemon 仅根据持久化记录自动恢复身份、角色、anchor 和绑定，并更新 context 投影；此身份恢复不要求也不触发回环测试，身份恢复与当前通信可达性分开。仅在通信不通且进入手动通信恢复时，才对恢复路径执行回环测试，并以其结果确认通信可达；回环失败不撤销已恢复身份或角色。daemon 自动处理后台身份恢复、状态同步、订阅和通知；context 返回当前注册身份和项目全体 peer/master 状态。用户要求 master 或 peer 时，用户授权优先，daemon 直接覆盖已有身份/角色映射。所有消息均先由 daemon 中心接收、持久化和派发；agent 只指定收件人，不做 agent-to-agent 直连或 transport 选择。周期通知、长程通知、订阅消息、回环及双向通信按独立事实流持久化；入队、adaptor 接受、接收和消费状态按真实回执区分。用户未指定的周期、重试、聚合和提醒参数不臆定。

request.text: Collab orchestration and standing patrol use one project-generic contract. General execution and observation children use an independent `codex exec --profile gcm`, with only the documented fallback when GCM is unavailable; production concurrency must not use built-in spawn/fork/session Agent slots or managed subagents. The Collab master audits, dispatches, verifies, integrates, and keeps eligible capacity saturated without replacing the delivery owner for ordinary scoped implementation. Long-horizon work belongs to a peer, which orchestrates concurrent independent GCM workers; a master-owned independent GCM worker starts only when every eligible peer is busy. Every patrol converges project-generic objects: remove unneeded owned worktrees only after recoverable extraction; reclaim owned stale resources; close each open P0/P1 with applicable evidence or explicitly park it with owner, cause, and unblock condition; route each new production issue through the project's canonical issue intake before repair; and preserve and report dirty, active, shared, or unknown resources as protected holds. Before a patrol cycle ends, re-arm a consumed one-shot goal or deadline wake when continued scheduling is required; reading, ACK, status summary, and dispatch receipt are never completion. This contract must not contain RouteCodex paths, error codes, dashboard fields, or other project-specific implementation details; those checks remain in the owning project Skill.

request.text: Collab orchestration and patrol use one project-generic contract. Master and ordinary peer are both autonomous long-horizon goal orchestrators at different goal levels; peer is not a bounded execution worker. Each registers, reads, updates, rearms and cancels its own goal. Master must not proxy-register or hold a peer goal. Stable name owns work; agent sessionID is its current execution carrier, independent of tmux and worktree placement. Goal status and lifecycle changes must not rewrite another owner's records. Ordinary tasks, board assignments, notes and timer subscriptions do not substitute for a real goal registration receipt. Route suitable long-horizon subgoals to consenting authorized peers; route bounded execution and observation directly to independent codex exec --profile gcm subworkers regardless of peer availability, using only the documented fallback when unavailable. Keep Plan/Review roles and host primitives separate; do not use built-in spawn/fork/session Agent slots or legacy managed subagents as production concurrency. Both orchestrators plan, dispatch, manage resources, verify evidence, unblock, integrate and deliver their own goal. On each assignment evaluate goal/dependencies/blockers/priority/resources and update finite owned patrols without duplicate timers. Patrol checks open P0/P1 work, actual subtask progress, owned worktree/runtime cleanup, canonical issue intake and relevant events; preserve protected dirty, active, shared or unknown resources. Peer requests master help for blockers without transferring goal ownership. Rearm a consumed one-shot wake only while actionable scheduling remains; ACK/read/summary are not completion. On goal completion or no new task and no actionable work, actively close owned goal scheduling and patrols while keeping direct-message reception. Audit all active AppSDK project prompts, runtime generators, templates, source and installed Skills for conflicting roles, logic gaps and duplicated rule owners; remove incorrect instructions, retain one authoritative owner and distinguish generated projections from independent sources. Preserve legitimate current-master project arbitration, reset, master-idle and cross-project boundaries; global daemon lifecycle remains user-managed and is not an identity or project reset prerequisite. Keep this contract project-generic; business-specific checks belong to their project Skill.
